CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to identified content in text.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), presentation/organization (coordinate system + positions) and a distinct origin/status field are all explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention or allocation relation linking processing/attention to specific content/organization is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color-labelled coordinate sets) are present in the report.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate, etc.) separate identification of content from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is presented (coordinate orientation, explicit coordinate sets) and includes candidate/current organization variants.
